facts.fact: The strategy states that statistical activity in Togo is governed by Law No. 2011-014 of 3 June 2011 on the organisation of statistical activity, promulgated in 2011 and creating the National Statistics Council and INSEED.
facts.system: Loi n°2011-014 du 03 juin 2011 portant organisation de l'activité statistique au Togo

facts.fact: The strategy cites Decree No. 2012-269/PR of 7 November 2012 on the composition, organisation and operation of the National Statistics Council as an implementing text of the statistics law.
facts.system: Loi n°2011-014 du 03 juin 2011 portant organisation de l'activité statistique au Togo

facts.fact: The strategy cites Decree No. 2015-020/PR of 24 February 2015 setting the functions, organisation and operating rules of INSEED as an implementing text of the statistics law.
facts.system: Loi n°2011-014 du 03 juin 2011 portant organisation de l'activité statistique au Togo
